title: Separable algebraic extensions remain separable over an intermediate base
statement: Let $A\subseteq B\subseteq E$ be inclusions of fields [def-pc-field-extension]. If $E/A$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], then $E/B$ is separable algebraic. No finiteness hypothesis is imposed.
